title: Anti Money Laundering
overview: This course delivers a detailed and practical examination of money laundering schemes, anti-money laundering (AML) legislation, and effective countermeasures. Participants will explore the complexities of preventing money laundering and safeguarding their organizations. The course addresses various laundering schemes, methods for tracing illicit funds, necessary records for analysis, and techniques for identifying financial leads.

With real-world examples and recent AML regulation breaches, this program emphasizes the financial and reputational risks associated with non-compliance. It provides participants with insights into both Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) and international AML regulations, equipping them to protect their organizations effectively
audience: This course is ideal for senior managers responsible for developing or implementing AML policies and procedures. It is also highly relevant for financial officers, controllers, accountants, AML reporting officers, compliance professionals, managers, auditors, and others with roles requiring AML compliance.
methodology: This highly interactive course encourages active participation for optimal learning. Attendees can present their own cases for discussion, engage in team activities, and analyze case studies and practical examples to reinforce key concepts.
competencies: Understanding the AML process and cycle
Identifying money laundering schemes and methods
Analyzing financial records and tracing illicit funds
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Detect and prevent money laundering activities.
Understand the money laundering process and its stages.
Identify common methods used to commit money laundering.
Apply GCC and international AML laws and regulations.
Analyze financial records to uncover potential laundering schemes.
Utilize proven methods to trace income or funds from unknown sources.
